title: Mazda RX-7 in the Night Studio at 2 AM
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Don't plan the whole night. Plan the next hour.
description:
Step inside the Night Studio at two in the morning, where the quiet room holds a striking giallo yellow Mazda RX-7 FD resting under the soft light. Beyond the window, the whole city has fallen asleep, leaving just you and the familiar glow of your screens. You are surrounded by two hours of music-only, mellow lo-fi hip hop woven with jazzy keys and a soft head-nod beat. It is a calm space carved out for you, perfect for working, studying, and relaxing.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
